meta.title: Traffic Light: vendors see a colour status only
gaps: The catalog cannot reliably assert that no competitor price is shown as distinct from the vendor's own bid-sheet Price field; it can only check absence of the generic Price label.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot reliably assert that no competitor price is shown as distinct from the vendor's own bid-sheet Price field; it can only check absence of the generic Price label.

steps.note: Open the single-stage flow required for traffic-light auction configuration.
Configure the auction's traffic-light strategy and range.
Apply the first available auction template before adding line items.
Add one item for the vendor to bid on.
Invite the QA vendor whose portal view will be checked.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the auction's vendor bidding screen.
Submit a bid within the configured traffic-light range.
Verify that the vendor receives the expected green colour status.
Verify that the vendor view does not expose a rank.
Check that the vendor view does not show the generic price label.
